description: Self-employed periodic tax returns of a year as computed by Cuéntamo for the account book's tax regime (Spain: VAT form 303 and income-tax instalment form 130, or the regional/IGIC equivalents): amounts per period, payment calendar with due dates, and warnings. The figures already apply the regime's rules (accrual dates, deductibility, periods marked as filed). Needs the self-employed module.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

period.description: Quarter (1-4) or month, depending on the regime. Omit for the whole year.

name: get_tax_periods
title: Quarterly tax returns (self-employed)
